PDF.js (mozilla/pdf.js), the `pdfjs-dist` 6.4.299 build (`build/pdf.min.mjs`, `build/pdf.worker.min.mjs`), as
handcraft's book and comic readers used it. Used by the `book-studio` package (loaded as the `pdfjs` and
`pdfjs-worker` bytes packages) to read a PDF book's pages, its cover and its title. Licence: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE).
